title: Left Join Product Names
description:
The sales feed only has cryptic `product_id`s. Merchandising keeps a small product catalog with human-readable names. Some ids in sales are brand new and not in the catalog yet — those sales still need to show up, just without a name.

**Left-join** sales (`INPUT_PATH`) to products (`PRODUCTS_PATH`) on `product_id` and add `product_name`. Keep every sales row; missing catalog matches → `product_name` is null. Write Parquet with overwrite.

Sales columns: `txn_id`, `product_id`, `store_id`, `quantity`. Products columns: `product_id` (unique), `product_name`. Output: all sales columns plus `product_name`. Use an explicit left join (`how="left"`) — an inner join would drop unmatched sales. Implement with Spark DataFrame APIs — no driver-side nested loops over `collect`. **Run** uses two smoke testcases; **Submit** uses the full set and row-diffs your Parquet against each case’s `expected/`.

Write results with `df.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(OUTPUT_PATH)`. `OUTPUT_PATH` is set by the platform for **this Run/Submit only**.

problemStatement.overview: Left-join sales to products on product_id; keep unmatched sales with null product_name; write Parquet to OUTPUT_PATH.
symptoms: Dashboards show raw product_ids instead of catalog names.
New SKUs in sales are missing from the catalog — those rows must still appear.
yourTaskSteps: Read sales from INPUT_PATH and products from PRODUCTS_PATH.
Left-join on product_id and add product_name (null when unmatched).
Write txn_id, product_id, store_id, quantity, product_name to OUTPUT_PATH with overwrite.
Submit is graded with a row-level compare against each selected testcase expected/.
problemStatement.yourTask: Implement src/main.py that left-joins sales to the product catalog.
hints: An inner join would quietly drop sales rows whose product_id is not in the catalog.
Product keys are unique — you should get one output row per sales row.
broadcast(products) is allowed but not required.
spark.read.parquet(INPUT_PATH) reads every staged sales testcase file.

expectedOutput.description: From products via left join; null if unmatched

gradeChecks: Spark job succeeds on selected Submit testcases
OUTPUT_PATH Parquet readable with sales columns plus product_name
Each Submit testcase expected/ matches candidate rows (key + values)
No extra rows beyond the union of selected expected testcases
